title: Spring Skate Jam 2026
body:
Kick off spring with ODA's annual Spring Skate Jam! Open to all ages and skill levels — whether you're just learning to ollie or you're a seasoned street skater, come out and ride with us.

Free entry. Free food for youth under 18. Prizes for best trick, best dressed, and most stoked. Board giveaways at noon courtesy of our sponsors.

Bring your board, bring a friend, and bring your best energy. See you at Erie Street Market on April 19th!
